attr.title: Adonthell - Waste's Edge
attr.desc: A free 2D role-playing game in the style of classic SNES RPGs. As a loyal servant of the elven Lady Silverhair you arrive at the remote trading post of Waste's Edge, where a theft threatens to ruin your mistress' reputation. Explore the Redwyne Inn, talk to its guests and uncover the truth.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
